During the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a proxy conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], an ancient '''navigational probe''' was located in the [[Raxus system/Legends|Raxus system]]. Eventually, someone was sent to [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] into the probe's [[Datacore/Legends|datacore]] and discover its origins.<ref name="SLI">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Secrets of the Past}}</ref>
